channel.description: Parts for the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros

item.g:title: Service Filter Kit – 5 Filters for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473
item.g:description: Everything for a standard oil service in one box: engine oil filter, fuel filter kit, fuel pre-filter / water separator, engine air filter and cabin pollen filter. $20 less than buying them separately.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Oil Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 472 184 04 25
item.g:description: Engine oil filter element (cartridge type) for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Fits inside the plastic filter housing on the engine and comes with new O-rings. Change it at every oil service, and match the number on your old element: it replaces OE A 472 184 04 25 and the A 473 180 00 09 / A 472 180 01 09 family, and is the same size as MAHLE OX 832D, MANN HU 12 001 z and Hengst E510H07 D129. Replaces OE A 472 184 04 25, A 472 184 05 25, A 472 180 03 09, A 472 180 01 09, A 473 180 00 09. Cross-reference: MAHLE OX 832D, MANN HU 12 001 z, Hengst E510H07 D129, Luber-finer LP5090, Baldwin P7505, Bosch F 026 407 192, Wix 57909, Donaldson P551005, Fleetguard LF17511.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Filter Kit for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 471 090 27 55
item.g:description: Main fuel filter kit for the OM471 / OM473: filter element, small mesh pre-strainer and O-rings. Keeps dirt out of the injection system. Change at every service. Replaces OE A 471 090 27 55, A 471 090 24 55. Cross-reference: MAHLE KX 581KIT, MANN PU 12 002-2 z, Hengst E445KP D314-2.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Air Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 004 094 69 04
item.g:description: Engine air filter element for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A blocked air filter costs power and fuel, so check it at every service and replace it when the restriction indicator shows or at least once a year, sooner on dusty roads. Same size as MAHLE LX 5437, MANN C 50 004/1 and Hengst E2059L. Note the element is about 491 mm long, so it ships in its own box. Replaces OE A 004 094 69 04, A 004 094 68 04. Cross-reference: MAHLE LX 5437, MANN C 50 004/1, Hengst E2059L.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Cabin Pollen Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 830 02 18
item.g:description: Cab pollen filter for the heater and air conditioning on the MP4 / MP5 cab. Replace yearly or when airflow drops. A carbon version (A 960 830 01 18) is also fitted to some trucks, so send us your VIN if unsure. Replaces OE A 960 830 02 18. Cross-reference: MAHLE LA 1006.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: AdBlue Pump Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 000 142 05 89
item.g:description: AdBlue (urea, DEF) pump filter for the SCR emissions system on the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A blocked AdBlue filter starves the dosing pump, which can bring up an emissions warning and put the truck into derate (limp mode). Change it with the AdBlue system service. MAHLE lists UX 13KIT (OE A 000 142 05 89) for MP4 / MP5 trucks; check the number on your old filter or send us your VIN. Replaces OE A 000 142 05 89. Cross-reference: MAHLE UX 13KIT.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Pre-filter / Water Separator for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 960 477 00 03
item.g:description: Spin-on fuel pre-filter / water separator can for the OM471 / OM473, supplied with a new O-ring. Traps water and coarse dirt before the main fuel filter. Change at every service and drain water as needed. Replaces OE A 960 477 00 03. Cross-reference: MAHLE KC 505D, MANN PL 420/7 x, Hengst H356WK.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Power Steering Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 000 184 22 25
item.g:description: Power steering hydraulic filter for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Replace it whenever you change the steering fluid, or if the steering feels heavy or the pump is noisy. MAHLE lists HX 15 (OE A 000 184 22 25) for MP4 / MP5 trucks; check the number on your old filter or send us your VIN. Replaces OE A 000 184 22 25. Cross-reference: MAHLE HX 15.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Air Dryer Cartridge for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 000 429 20 97
item.g:description: Spin-on air dryer cartridge with oil separator for the air processing unit on the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Keeps water and oil out of the brake air system. Change it every 1 to 2 years, or sooner if you're draining water from the tanks. Check your old cartridge has the M41 x 2 thread before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 000 429 20 97, A 000 429 21 97, A 000 429 37 95. Cross-reference: Knorr-Bremse K163455, MANN TB 1394/8 x, Mahle AL 35, febi 106249, Hengst T380W, Haldex 31005509.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Brake Hose Set with M22 Connectors for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 002 420 93 48
item.g:description: Brake hose (OE A 002 420 93 48) supplied as a set with 2 brass push-in connectors (OE A 000 997 81 34, M22x1.5 thread, with seals), ready to fit. Replaces OE A 002 420 93 48, A 000 997 81 34.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Front Brake Pad Set (Axle Set) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 006 420 14 20
item.g:description: Front axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SM7 disc brakes. 4 pads plus a repair kit, enough to do both front wheels. Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29246 or 29247) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 006 420 14 20, A 006 420 52 20, A 000 421 72 10. Cross-reference: WVA 29246, WVA 29247, Knorr-Bremse SM7, Ferodo FCV4417PTS, Febi 16997.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Rear Brake Pad Set (Axle Set) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 006 420 53 20
item.g:description: Rear axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SL7 disc brakes. 4 pads plus a repair kit, enough to do both wheels on one rear axle (order 2 sets for a tandem drive). Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29244 or 29245) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 006 420 53 20, A 006 420 15 20. Cross-reference: WVA 29244, WVA 29245, Knorr-Bremse SL7, Ferodo FCV4418PTS.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: ABS/EBS Suzi Coil – 7 Core ISO 7638 Trailer Cable for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: ABS/EBS 7 core trailer plug cable for trailer stability control. A coiled suzi with ISO 7638 7-pin plugs at both ends that carries power and data between the prime mover and the trailer's ABS/EBS brake module (Wabco, Knorr-Bremse or Haldex), including roll stability control. Suits the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros and any prime mover and trailer with ISO 7638 sockets, and replaces Narva, Hella and Trail Link 7 core EBS suzi coils. Replace it if the trailer ABS/EBS warning light comes on, the plugs are loose or cracked, or the coil is cut or flattened. Cross-reference: Narva 82560, Narva 82562, Hella 8KA 227 440-081, Trail Link EL100913LT.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: 7 Pin Trailer Suzi Coil – Lighting Cable for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: 7 pin coiled suzi that carries the trailer light circuits (tail, stop, indicators and auxiliary) from the prime mover to the trailer. Metal-bodied plugs with a spring guard to stop the cable kinking at the plug. An alternative to Narva, Hella and Trail Link 7 core trailer suzi coils. For the trailer brakes' ABS/EBS connection use our ABS/EBS suzi coil. Check the plug on your truck and trailer matches before you order, or call us and we'll confirm. Cross-reference: Narva 82524, Narva 82529.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Main Mirror Cover (Long) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 811 06 07
item.g:description: Replacement back cover for the long main mirror (long-arm mirror). Left-hand / passenger side is OE A 960 811 06 07, right-hand / driver's side is OE A 960 811 07 07. Choose your side. Replaces OE A 960 811 06 07, A 960 811 07 07.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: H7 24V 70W Headlight Globes (Pair) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: A pair of H7 24 volt 70 watt halogen headlight globes with the PX26d base, for the halogen headlights on the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Change both sides together so the beams match. Pull your old globe and check it says H7 24V before you order. Cross-reference: Narva 48728, Narva 48729, Osram 64215, Osram Truckstar Pro 64215TSP, Philips 13972MDB1.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Corner Mirror Cover (Small) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 811 14 07
item.g:description: Replacement back cover for the small corner (lower, wide-angle) mirror that sits under the main mirror. Left-hand / passenger side is OE A 960 811 14 07, right-hand / driver's side is OE A 960 811 15 07. Choose your side. Pairs with our long main mirror cover. Replaces OE A 960 811 14 07, A 960 811 15 07.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Viscous Fan Clutch for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471 – OE A 470 200 07 22
item.g:description: Viscous fan clutch (viscous coupling) for the engine cooling fan on the OM471 MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Signs it has failed: the engine runs hot on hills or in traffic, the fan roars all the time, or oil is leaking from the hub. Replaces OE A 470 200 07 22, same as MAHLE CFC 173 000P, NRF 49159 and Nissens 86140. Replaces OE A 470 200 07 22. Cross-reference: NRF 49159, Nissens 86140, MAHLE CFC 173 000P.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Coolant Expansion Tank for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 501 42 03
item.g:description: Coolant expansion tank (header tank) for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. The plastic tank cracks with age and heat, so coolant loss, a sweet smell or crusty coolant around the tank are the usual signs. Replace the cap at the same time if it doesn't hold pressure. Replaces OE A 960 501 42 03 (also A 960 501 87 03), same as MAHLE CRT 235 000P and Nissens 996053. Replaces OE A 960 501 42 03, A 960 501 87 03. Cross-reference: MAHLE CRT 235 000P, Nissens 996053.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Clutch Kit for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: Complete clutch kit for the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros with the PowerShift automated gearbox: clutch plate (disc), pressure plate and release bearing. Signs it's due: slipping under load, juddering when taking off, or a clutch wear warning on the dash. Clutch kits differ by gearbox and engine, so send us your VIN and we'll confirm the right kit before you pay.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Clutch Actuator (PowerShift) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: Clutch actuator (clutch servo) for the PowerShift automated manual gearbox in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. A failing actuator causes rough or slow take-offs, the clutch not fully releasing, air leaks at the actuator, or clutch fault codes on the dash. Send us your VIN and we'll confirm it matches your gearbox before you pay.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Starter Motor 24V 7.5kW for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 007 151 45 01
item.g:description: 24V 7.5kW starter motor for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros, including the Actros 2658. Replace it if the engine cranks slowly with good batteries, the starter clicks but doesn't turn, or it grinds on engagement. Replaces OE A 007 151 45 01, same as MAHLE MS 754 and Prestolite (TRP 1549007). Replaces OE A 007 151 45 01. Cross-reference: Prestolite (TRP 1549007), S5307S, DRS1034, 11139182, AZG4879, MAHLE MS 754.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Cylinder Liner Kit (OM473) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: Cylinder liner kit for the OM473 15.6 litre engine in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros (2658, 2663), for an in-frame or out-of-frame engine rebuild. Liner kits vary by piston and engine build, so send us your VIN or engine number and we'll confirm the right kit and lead time.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Timing Tool Kit for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: Engine timing tool kit for the OM471 and OM473 engines in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Locks the camshafts and crankshaft in position for timing work, cylinder head jobs and cam replacement. Ask us what's in the kit and the lead time.

item.g:title: Oil Spinner (Crankcase Oil Separator) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 471 010 01 62
item.g:description: Oil spinner (crankcase ventilation oil separator) for the OM471 and OM473 engines. Check the number on your old unit matches A 471 010 01 62 or A 472 010 31 62, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm. Replaces OE A 471 010 01 62, A 472 010 31 62.

item.g:title: Battery Terminal Sensor (Negative) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 012 542 62 18
item.g:description: Battery sensor on the negative battery terminal. Check the number on your old sensor matches A 012 542 62 18, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm. Replaces OE A 012 542 62 18.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Pneumatic Oil Drum Pump with Hose and Metered Gun
item.g:description: Air-operated pump for dispensing engine oil from a drum, supplied with a 5 m delivery hose and a metered dispensing gun that shows how much oil has been pumped. Runs off workshop compressed air. Suits any truck or workshop.
item.g:google_product_category: Hardware > Tools

item.g:title: Exhaust Manifold Gasket (OM473) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 472 142 18 80
item.g:description: Aftermarket exhaust manifold gasket to suit the OM473 15.6 litre engine in the MP4 / MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros 2658 and 2663. Replace it if you hear an exhaust tick or blow at the manifold, see soot marks around the manifold joints, or whenever the manifold or turbo comes off. There are two: A 472 142 18 80 for cylinders 1-3 and A 472 142 19 80 for cylinders 4-6. Pick the position you need, and add one of each to do the whole engine. Priced per gasket. Replaces OE A 472 142 18 80, A 472 142 19 80.
